companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.moat: Monopoly CUDA software ecosystem + NVLink interconnect clustering fabric
companies.risk: Hyperscaler custom ASIC displacement (Trainium/TPU) and TSMC CoWoS packaging allocation constraints
companies.investment_verdict: Core Anchor: Indispensable compute tax collector for the entire AI supercycle.

companies.name: Taiwan Semiconductor (TSMC)
companies.moat: Sole volume manufacturer of sub-3nm silicon and CoWoS advanced packaging
companies.risk: Geopolitical Taiwan Strait vulnerability and high CapEx depreciation burden
companies.investment_verdict: Foundational Monopoly: Every single frontier GPU and custom ASIC must flow through TSMC.

companies.name: ASML Holding
companies.moat: 100% global monopoly on Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) lithography scanners
companies.risk: China export control bans and cyclical foundry fab expansion pauses
companies.investment_verdict: Deep Supply Chain Tollbooth: Physics-level monopoly with zero commercial competition.

companies.name: Broadcom
companies.moat: Dominant custom AI ASIC co-designer for Google TPU, Meta MTIA, and OpenAI silicon
companies.risk: Customer concentration in top hyperscaler custom silicon projects
companies.investment_verdict: ASIC Winner: Direct hedge against NVIDIA GPU dominance with high software cash flow.

companies.name: Constellation Energy
companies.moat: Largest nuclear fleet in US; 20-year Microsoft Three Mile Island PPA at premium tariff ($110+/MWh)
companies.risk: Regulatory FERC grid interconnect co-location objections from local utilities
companies.investment_verdict: Top Nuclear Pick: Clean 24/7 baseload power is the ultimate physical constraint of AI.

companies.name: Vertiv Holdings
companies.moat: Dominant supplier of liquid cooling distribution units (CDUs) and high-density power conditioning
companies.risk: Supply chain component bottlenecks and commoditization of basic server racks
companies.investment_verdict: Thermal Pick & Shovel: High-density 100kW+ GPU racks cannot function without liquid cooling.

companies.name: Vistra Corp
companies.moat: Nuclear (Comanche Peak) + ERCOT gas generation positioned at the heart of Texas AI boom
companies.risk: Merchant wholesale electricity price volatility during mild winters
companies.investment_verdict: High Beta Power Play: Massive leverage to rising Texas wholesale electricity pricing.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.moat: Azure hyperscaler cloud + OpenAI exclusive partnership + enterprise Office distribution
companies.risk: Massive $80B+ annual CapEx spend with long depreciation payback cycles
companies.investment_verdict: Scale King: The most diversified commercial AI platform across enterprise, cloud, and consumer.

companies.name: Arista Networks
companies.moat: EOS operating system + market leadership in 800G Ultra Ethernet AI cluster switching
companies.risk: NVIDIA InfiniBand bundled ecosystem competition in Greenfield GPU pods
companies.investment_verdict: Networking Champion: Standard Ethernet will dominate long-term hyperscaler AI scale-out.

companies.name: Palantir Technologies
companies.moat: AIP (Artificial Intelligence Platform) + deep government defense & enterprise ontology integration
companies.risk: Extreme valuation multiple requiring sustained 35%+ revenue growth execution
companies.investment_verdict: Enterprise Agent Standard: Unique ontology architecture unlocks real enterprise ROI.

companies.name: ServiceNow
companies.moat: Core system of record for enterprise IT, HR, and customer workflows with native agentic automation
companies.risk: Enterprise IT budget scrutiny and competition from Salesforce / Microsoft Copilot
companies.investment_verdict: High Quality SaaS Compounder: Best positioned to monetize agentic workflows across Fortune 500.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.moat: Dominant consumer brand (ChatGPT 250M+ WAU) + reasoning frontier models (o1/o3 series)
companies.risk: Massive annual compute training cash burn (~$5B/year) and open-source model replication
companies.investment_verdict: Frontier Standard: Category-defining pioneer with the highest consumer and enterprise mindshare.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.moat: Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmark dominance in coding and autonomous agentic workflows
companies.risk: Intense capital competition against OpenAI and Google DeepMind balance sheets
companies.investment_verdict: Developer's Choice: Highest quality reasoning and tool-use model for coding and agent systems.

companies.name: CoreWeave
companies.moat: Preferred NVIDIA cloud partner with multi-gigawatt contracted data center pipeline
companies.risk: High debt load for GPU leasing and hyperscaler internal buildout pressure
companies.investment_verdict: Pure-Play AI Cloud: Leading neo-cloud preparing for major 2025/2026 public IPO.

companies.name: Cursor (Anysphere)
companies.moat: Beloved developer UX + deep codebase indexing + VS Code fork workflow stickiness
companies.risk: GitHub Copilot platform bundling and frontier model native IDE tooling
companies.investment_verdict: Breakout Agent Unicorn: Fastest scaling AI application in software engineering history.

companies.name: Scale AI
companies.moat: Dominant data annotation pipeline & RLHF evaluation engine for all frontier labs
companies.risk: Synthetic data generation displacing manual human annotation pipelines
companies.investment_verdict: Frontier Lab Supplier: Essential training data infrastructure for frontier LLM creators.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.moat: Data Intelligence Platform (Lakehouse) + MosaicML open training infrastructure
companies.risk: Snowflake data cloud competition and enterprise cloud optimization cycles
companies.investment_verdict: Enterprise Data Backbone: Critical enterprise data lakehouse preparing for marquee IPO.
